messages.subject: parameters to keep few measurements across runs in MSstatsPTM
parts:
Hi, I am trying to process my MaxQuant_output_data with MSstatsPTM, as I noticed , it will remove features with less than 3 measurements across runs as default option.

In some cases, I prepared less than 3 replicates and some features are only measurable in less than 3 replicates. And I have to keep those few measurements, but I can not find out corresponding option in the function "MaxQtoMSstatsPTMFormat", can you point out/add options to make it availiable ?

messages.subject: Re: parameters to keep few measurements across runs in MSstatsPTM

Hello,

Currently this option is available in the base MaxQtoMSstatsFormat function from MSstats but not in the MaxQtoMSstatsPTMFormat function. It is straightforward to add so I will update the PTM function to give the user the option to keep these features. I will respond to this thread when it is available (probably next week).

Devon
